name: onboarding-path-builder-login-oauth
title: Onboarding Path Builder with sign-in
about: The same brief, applied through the login-oauth connector (POST /v1/templates/{id}/apply, as the console's Apply sheet does) as a NEW app, so the connector path is in the gate: the template's brief, reference code, test-default secrets, egress and its template_tests gate. The connector starts the fast_fix workflow, whose first step is the build; the gate follows that build's code task and does not wait for the release gate after it.
note_lead:
Build the app below as ONE Node 20 Express app (plain JavaScript ESM) that serves its own pages and its /api from one process, stores its data server-side, and puts the buddy dashboard and the path editor behind the template's sign-in. `npm test` must pass.
